newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico on road to 6 pct annual GDP growth - Ortiz.
newsitem.headline: Mexico on road to 6 pct annual GDP growth - Ortiz.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz on Monday said that Mexico was on course for future annual GDP growth rates of six percent.

In a meeting with business leaders from the southeastern state of Yucatan, Ortiz said it was official government economic policy this year "to consolidate a process of sustainable economic growth of greater than six percent" for gross domestic product.
The government goal for GDP growth this year is 4.5 percent, while holding inflation to 15 percent and deficit spending to 0.5 percent of GDP, Ortiz said.
Ortiz added that "1997 will be a year of transition to place the economy on a trajectory of high growth through policies of promoting savings."
